faculty_override_note: The official two-year map is the default. The official five-semester map is an alternate lighter-load pathway.
sequence_notes: MAT 206 precedes MAT 301, which precedes MAT 302 and MAT 303.
The first laboratory science is BIO 210, CHE 201, PHY 210, or PHY 215.
The Scientific World selection is BIO 220, CHE 202, CSC 110, CSC 111, PHY 220, or PHY 225.
SPE 100 and SPE 102 are alternatives; only one is required.
The second Creative Expression course cannot be SPE 100 or SPE 102.
Four program electives totaling at least 12 credits are required.
A Writing Intensive course is required for graduation.
